Stage 2: Accept the order

The process of the stage, and where each process step is measured exists proposed cannot be counted

Expectations, entry, outcomes and alerts

Time limit in the code
2 minutes from entering Submitted, read from the timing: a 1-minute grace period and up to 30 seconds to the next poll, then 10 seconds before Stock confirmed and 10 before Paid (proposed)
Expected by each party
  • The customer who placed the order: the order is accepted when the shopper expects, and not lost to a payment outage (proposed).
    Met when: the order in Paid, or Cancelled for lack of stock or the customer's request (proposed).
    Objective: not stated.
A case enters
  • from Stage 1: Expected outcome: The order is placed
Expected outcomes
  • Payment is taken for the order (→ Stage 3)
Other outcomes
  • The order is cancelled because an item is out of stock (ends the flow)
  • The order is cancelled because payment failed (ends the flow)
  • The order is cancelled at the customer's request (ends the flow)
Cannot be undone
  • Expected outcome: Payment is taken for the order
  • Other outcome: The order is cancelled because an item is out of stock
  • Other outcome: The order is cancelled because payment failed
  • Other outcome: The order is cancelled at the customer's request
At stake

  • For the whole flow:

    • Order id ("Id").
    • Order total (sum of Units x UnitPrice).
    • Items and units (ordering."orderItems").
    • Buyer (ordering.buyers "IdentityGuid").
    • Delivery address.
    • Payment method (card number masked to the last four digits).
Its alerts
  • Orders past the acceptance time limit, by state
  • Orders cancelled in acceptance because payment failed
